block: R
title: Relation command boundaries
claim: Compare adjacent TeX rows.

step: R.1
title: Align consecutive relations
claim: Start a new chain when a left-hand side appears.
- x\ge2 @@ First left-hand side
- \le1 @@ Digit after the command
- \leq_{a}2 @@ Underscore after the command
- \left(y\right)\geq3 @@ New left-hand side
- \ge_42 @@ Continuation of the new chain
